tables.name: crablet_automation_progress
tables.comment: Progress tracking for event-driven automations. Each automation tracks its own position independently.

columns.name: automation_name
columns.comment: Unique name of the automation.

columns.name: instance_id
columns.comment: Instance ID of the leader processing this automation.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Status: ACTIVE, PAUSED, or FAILED.

columns.name: last_position
columns.comment: Last processed event position. Events with position > last_position will be processed.

columns.name: error_count
columns.comment: Number of consecutive errors. Automation is marked FAILED if it exceeds the configured threshold.

columns.name: last_transaction_id
columns.comment: Transaction id half of the progress cursor: events with (transaction_id, position) > (last_transaction_id, last_position) are processed next.

indexes.name: crablet_automation_progress_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crablet_automation_progress_pkey ON public.crablet_automation_progress USING btree (automation_name)

tables.name: crablet_commands
tables.comment: Command audit log. One row per executed command, linked to crablet_events via transaction_id.

columns.name: transaction_id
columns.comment: PostgreSQL xid8 for the command execution transaction; joins to crablet_events.transaction_id for events produced by the command. Not a business transaction ID.

indexes.name: crablet_commands_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crablet_commands_pkey ON public.crablet_commands USING btree (command_id)

indexes.name: idx_crablet_commands_transaction_id
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_crablet_commands_transaction_id ON public.crablet_commands USING btree (transaction_id)

indexes.name: crablet_deadline_progress_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crablet_deadline_progress_pkey ON public.crablet_deadline_progress USING btree (processor_name)

tables.name: crablet_deadlines
tables.comment: Pending deadlines (crablet.DeadlineScheduled events not yet fired), by due time. Written by append_events_batch, deleted when the deadline fires; rebuildable from the log.

indexes.name: crablet_deadlines_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crablet_deadlines_pkey ON public.crablet_deadlines USING btree (deadline_position)

indexes.name: idx_crablet_deadlines_due
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_crablet_deadlines_due ON public.crablet_deadlines USING btree (due_at, deadline_position)

tables.name: crablet_event_tag_keys
tables.comment: Derived: one row per (tag key, event position), maintained atomically from crablet_events.tags on append, so the pollers can ask which events carry a tag with a given key. crablet_events.tags is the source of truth; this table can be rebuilt from it.

indexes.name: crablet_event_tag_keys_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crablet_event_tag_keys_pkey ON public.crablet_event_tag_keys USING btree (key, "position")

tables.name: crablet_events
tables.comment: Canonical Crablet event log. tags is the source of truth for event tags.

columns.name: transaction_id
columns.comment: PostgreSQL xid8 for the transaction that appended this event; shared by all events appended in the same transaction and used to join command audit rows. Not a business transaction ID.

columns.name: correlation_id
columns.comment: Business operation thread ID shared by all events caused by one user request, including automation-triggered downstream events.

columns.name: causation_id
columns.comment: Position (crablet_events.position) of the event that directly triggered this event. NULL for direct user actions.

columns.name: request_fingerprint
columns.comment: SHA-256 of the command name and its encoded input, for the events of a command with an idempotency key; NULL otherwise. Compared when the key repeats.

columns.name: emit_key
columns.comment: For an event appended under a cause (an automation trigger): the request fingerprint and the event's place in its append. Unique per cause.

columns.name: event_id
columns.comment: The event's stable public id (uuidv7): the message id a sink is given. Not an order: order is (transaction_id, position).

indexes.name: crablet_events_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crablet_events_pkey ON public.crablet_events USING btree ("position")

indexes.name: idx_crablet_events_correlation_id
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_crablet_events_correlation_id ON public.crablet_events USING btree (correlation_id) WHERE (correlation_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_crablet_events_emit_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_crablet_events_emit_key ON public.crablet_events USING btree (causation_id, emit_key) WHERE (emit_key IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_crablet_events_tags_gin
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_crablet_events_tags_gin ON public.crablet_events USING gin (tags)

indexes.name: idx_crablet_events_transaction_position_btree
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_crablet_events_transaction_position_btree ON public.crablet_events USING btree (transaction_id, "position")

indexes.name: idx_crablet_events_type_position
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_crablet_events_type_position ON public.crablet_events USING btree (type, "position")

tables.name: crablet_outbox_topic_progress
tables.comment: Tracks last published event position per publisher per topic. Each publisher advances independently through events matching its topic criteria.

columns.name: leader_instance
columns.comment: Hostname/pod name of the instance currently holding the lock for this topic-publisher pair.

columns.name: leader_since
columns.comment: When the current instance became the leader.

columns.name: leader_heartbeat
columns.comment: Last heartbeat timestamp from the leader instance. Used to detect abandoned pairs when leader crashes.

columns.name: last_transaction_id
columns.comment: Transaction id half of the progress cursor: events with (transaction_id, position) > (last_transaction_id, last_position) are published next.

indexes.name: pk_crablet_outbox_topic_progress
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pk_crablet_outbox_topic_progress ON public.crablet_outbox_topic_progress USING btree (topic, publisher)

tables.name: crablet_view_progress
tables.comment: Progress tracking for view projections. Each view tracks its own position independently.

columns.name: view_name
columns.comment: Unique name of the view projection.

columns.name: instance_id
columns.comment: Instance ID of the leader processing this view.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Status: ACTIVE, PAUSED, or FAILED.

columns.name: last_position
columns.comment: Last processed event position. Events with position > last_position will be processed.

columns.name: error_count
columns.comment: Number of consecutive errors. View is marked FAILED if it exceeds the configured threshold.

columns.name: last_transaction_id
columns.comment: Transaction id half of the progress cursor: events with (transaction_id, position) > (last_transaction_id, last_position) are processed next.

indexes.name: crablet_view_progress_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crablet_view_progress_pkey ON public.crablet_view_progress USING btree (view_name)

functions.signature: append_events_batch(p_types text[], p_tags text[], p_data jsonb[], p_occurred_at timestamp with time zone, p_correlation_id uuid, p_causation_id bigint, p_request_fingerprint bytea)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_events_batch(p_types text[], p_tags text[], p_data jsonb[], p_occurred_at timestamp with time zone, p_correlation_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_causation_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_request_fingerprint bytea DEFAULT NULL::bytea)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_last_position BIGINT;
BEGIN
    WITH inserted AS (
        INSERT INTO crablet_events (type, tags, data, transaction_id, occurred_at,
                                    correlation_id, causation_id, request_fingerprint, emit_key)
            SELECT t.type,
                   t.tag_string::TEXT[],
                   t.data,
                   pg_current_xact_id(),
                   p_occurred_at,
                   p_correlation_id,
                   p_causation_id,
                   p_request_fingerprint,
                   -- the request and the event's place in it, for an append made under a cause (ADR-0035)
                   CASE WHEN p_causation_id IS NOT NULL AND p_request_fingerprint IS NOT NULL
                        THEN encode(p_request_fingerprint, 'hex') || '/' || t.ord END
            FROM UNNEST($1, $2, $3) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(type, tag_string, data, ord)
            RETURNING position, tags, type, data),
         tagged AS (
             INSERT INTO crablet_event_tag_keys (key, position)
                 SELECT DISTINCT split_part(tag, '=', 1), i.position
                 FROM inserted i,
                      LATERAL unnest(i.tags) AS tag
                 WHERE tag LIKE '%=%'),
         deadlines AS (
             INSERT INTO crablet_deadlines (deadline_position, due_at)
                 SELECT i.position, (i.data ->> 'dueAt')::timestamptz
                 FROM inserted i
                 WHERE i.type = 'crablet.DeadlineScheduled')
    SELECT max(position) INTO v_last_position FROM inserted;
    RETURN v_last_position;
END;
$function$
functions.comment: Inserts events (and one row per tag KEY of each in crablet_event_tag_keys), with the request fingerprint if given, and returns the position of the last one.

functions.signature: append_events_if(p_types text[], p_tags text[], p_data jsonb[], p_concurrency_items jsonb, p_after_cursor_position bigint, p_idempotency_items jsonb, p_occurred_at timestamp with time zone, p_correlation_id uuid, p_causation_id bigint, p_notify_channel text, p_notify_payload text, p_after_cursor_transaction_id xid8, p_require_fresh_transaction boolean, p_request_fingerprint bytea, p_after_snapshot pg_snapshot)
functions.comment: Atomically appends events if no duplicate (p_idempotency_items) and no conflicting event after the cursor (p_after_cursor_transaction_id, p_after_cursor_position) in (transaction_id, position) order (p_concurrency_items) exists; with p_after_snapshot, an event that snapshot (the read's) could see is not a conflict. Conditions are JSONB arrays of {types, tags} items, OR-ed together. Writers lock their own events' and their conditions' (type, tag) pairs with pg_advisory_xact_lock; requires READ COMMITTED. With p_require_fresh_transaction, refuses (CRB01) a transaction that has already written. Stores p_request_fingerprint on the events; a duplicate reports what it matched (crablet_items_duplicate).

functions.signature: crablet_items_match_any(p_items jsonb, p_after_position bigint, p_after_xid xid8, p_after_snapshot pg_snapshot)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crablet_items_match_any(p_items jsonb, p_after_position bigint, p_after_xid xid8, p_after_snapshot pg_snapshot DEFAULT NULL::pg_snapshot)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_item  JSONB;
    v_types TEXT[];
    v_tags  TEXT[];
    -- The snapshot's running transactions, read once: with the snapshot, only these and the ones from its xmax on are candidates.
    v_xip   XID8[] := CASE WHEN p_after_snapshot IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ARRAY(SELECT pg_snapshot_xip(p_after_snapshot)) END;
BEGIN
    FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
        LOOP
            v_types := ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(v_item -> 'types'));
            v_tags := ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(v_item -> 'tags'));
            IF EXISTS (SELECT 1
                       FROM crablet_events e
                       WHERE (p_after_position IS NULL
                           OR (p_after_xid IS NULL AND e.position > p_after_position)
                           OR (p_after_xid IS NOT NULL AND (e.transaction_id, e.position) > (p_after_xid, p_after_position)))
                         -- The caller's own earlier appends (a command's `prepare`) were part of what it loaded; they
                         -- are not settled, so they sit above the cursor, but they are not a concurrent change.
                         AND (p_after_xid IS NULL OR e.transaction_id IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id_if_assigned())
                         -- An event the read could see is not a change since the read, settled or not (ADR-0048). Not visible in the snapshot =
                         -- from its xmax on, or running when it was taken: NOT pg_visible_in_snapshot, written so the scan skips the visible ones.
                         AND (p_after_snapshot IS NULL
                           OR e.transaction_id >= pg_snapshot_xmax(p_after_snapshot)
                           OR e.transaction_id = ANY (v_xip))
                         AND (cardinality(v_types) = 0 OR e.type = ANY (v_types))
                         AND (cardinality(v_tags) = 0 OR e.tags @> v_tags)
                       LIMIT 1) THEN
                RETURN TRUE;
            END IF;
        END LOOP;
    RETURN FALSE;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crablet_leaf_lock_key(p_type text, p_tag text)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
SELECT hashtextextended('L:' || p_type || '|' || p_tag, 0)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crablet_progress_cursor_xid(p_last_position bigint)
 RETURNS xid8
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
SELECT CASE
           WHEN p_last_position = 0 THEN '0'::xid8
           ELSE COALESCE(
                   LEAST((SELECT e.transaction_id FROM crablet_events e WHERE e.position = p_last_position),
                         (SELECT MIN(e.transaction_id) FROM crablet_events e WHERE e.position > p_last_position)),
                   -- the event at last_position is gone and nothing is newer: everything left was processed
                   (SELECT MAX(e.transaction_id) FROM crablet_events e),
                   '0'::xid8)
       END
$function$

functions.signature: crablet_writer_lock_keys(p_types text[], p_tags text[], p_concurrency_items jsonb, p_idempotency_items jsonb)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crablet_writer_lock_keys(p_types text[], p_tags text[], p_concurrency_items jsonb, p_idempotency_items jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(k bigint, excl boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
WITH event_rows AS (SELECT p_types[i] AS type, p_tags[i]::TEXT[] AS tags
                    FROM generate_subscripts(p_types, 1) AS i),
     items AS (SELECT item.value AS item
               FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_concurrency_items, '[]'::JSONB)) AS item(value)
               UNION ALL
               SELECT item.value
               FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_idempotency_items, '[]'::JSONB)) AS item(value)),
     item_shapes AS (SELECT ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(item -> 'types')) AS types,
                            ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(item -> 'tags'))  AS tags
                     FROM items),
     wanted AS (
         -- events: exclusive on each (type, tag); shared on the type and on the global key
         SELECT crablet_leaf_lock_key(e.type, tag) AS k, TRUE AS excl
         FROM event_rows e, LATERAL unnest(e.tags) AS tag
         UNION ALL
         SELECT hashtextextended('T:' || e.type, 0), FALSE FROM event_rows e
         UNION ALL
         SELECT hashtextextended('G', 0), FALSE WHERE cardinality(p_types) > 0
         UNION ALL
         -- items with types and tags: exclusive on each (type, tag)
         SELECT crablet_leaf_lock_key(type, tag), TRUE
         FROM item_shapes s, LATERAL unnest(s.types) AS type, LATERAL unnest(s.tags) AS tag
         WHERE cardinality(s.types) > 0 AND cardinality(s.tags) > 0
         UNION ALL
         -- items with types but no tags: exclusive on the type (writers hold it shared)
         SELECT hashtextextended('T:' || type, 0), TRUE
         FROM item_shapes s, LATERAL unnest(s.types) AS type
         WHERE cardinality(s.types) > 0 AND cardinality(s.tags) = 0
         UNION ALL
         -- items with no types: exclusive on the global key (every writer holds it shared)
         SELECT hashtextextended('G', 0), TRUE
         FROM item_shapes s
         WHERE cardinality(s.types) = 0)
SELECT w.k, bool_or(w.excl) AS excl
FROM wanted w
GROUP BY w.k
$function$
